name: PCBs & controls
description: Control boards and electronic parts for AC units.
long_description: Modern ACs depend on control boards to manage sensors, timers, inverter drives and safety cut-outs. Voltage fluctuations and moisture are common causes of failure. We help source model-specific PCBs as well as sensors and display boards.
